base_requirement_text: When the user selects the Save option, the system shall write the current document to disk and display a confirmation message.

glossary.definition: A user-initiated command that triggers the persistence of the current in-memory document state to persistent storage.
The document instance currently active in the editor at the moment the save command is issued.
A non-modal status notification displayed in the status bar for three seconds after a successful save operation.

business_rules.rule: The write operation must complete successfully before the confirmation message is displayed. If the write fails, an error notification must be shown instead and no confirmation message is displayed.
